title: Sunomono (Cucumber Vinegar Salad)
description: Thin cucumber in a sweet-sharp rice vinegar dressing. No Thermomix needed, and it can be made while the gyoza filling chills.

steps.text: Slice the cucumbers ({{cucumbers}}) as thinly as you can, ideally on a mandoline. Toss with the salt ({{salt}}) and leave 10 minutes, then squeeze gently to shed the water. Do not skip this or the dressing dilutes.
If using the wakame ({{wakame}}), cover with cold water and leave 10 minutes to rehydrate, then drain and squeeze out.
Stir the vinegar ({{vinegar}}), sugar ({{sugar}}) and soy ({{soy}}) together until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the cucumber and wakame through the dressing and chill until serving. Scatter with the sesame seeds ({{sesame}}) at the table.

notes.title: Timing
notes.text: Best made no more than a couple of hours ahead, as the cucumber softens.

notes.title: Variations
notes.text: A pinch of chilli flakes or a few strips of ginger are common additions. Carrot in fine matchsticks takes it closer to a namasu. For sharper, drop the sugar to 2 tsp.
